mechanics.claim: Galio's next basic attack is periodically empowered with an uncancellable windup, bonus attack speed, and deals its damage to the target and all enemies near them.
mechanics.quote: '''Galio's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and deal {{pplevel|15 to 115|color=magic damage}} ... to the target and all enemies near them

mechanics.claim: Landing an ability on an enemy champion or epic monster reduces Colossal Smash's current cooldown by 3 seconds, once per cast, even if the hit was spell-shielded.
mechanics.quote: ''Colossal Smash's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds. This may occur only once per cast.

mechanics.claim: The portion of Colossal Smash's damage from its AD ratio can critically strike against all targets hit.
mechanics.quote: ''Colossal Smash's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}}

mechanics.claim: Colossal Smash deals basic damage (triggering on-hit/spell effects) to the primary target, and separately tagged area-of-effect proc damage to secondary targets.
mechanics.quote: ''Colossal Smash'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to the primary target but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}, while dealing {{tip|proc damage}} also tagged as {{tip|area of effect}} to secondary targets.

mechanics.claim: Spellblade damage from Colossal Smash is not converted to magic damage and only hits the primary target.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spellblade}} does not get converted to magic damage and it will deal its damage only to the primary target.

mechanics.claim: Colossal Smash applies on-hit effects to its primary target twice.
mechanics.quote: ''Colossal Smash'' applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to its primary target twice.{{bug}}

mechanics.claim: Galio gains the attack speed bonus even on non-empowered attacks as long as the ability is off cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Galio''' gains {{as|attack speed}} even on non-empowered attacks as long as the ability is not on cooldown.
